method.inputs: Public fixed map, existing refuge exit catalog, nominal motion parameters only
method.corridor: Enumerate maximal connected constant-heading chains; score length_mm * count(degree >= 3)
method.tie_break: Descending score, length, branch count; ascending heading and node path
method.search_prior: Minimum heading-aware nominal travel time from any dominant-corridor node, initially facing along either corridor direction, to a visible probe
method.probe_set: All original nodes and segment midpoints; a discrete proxy, not the exact continuous first-detection optimum
method.probe_gap_guarantee: Connected cardinal rays only; coordinate alignment cannot bridge a missing road
method.time_arithmetic: Exact rational millimeter/speed travel plus configured action milliseconds; rounded up once at path output
method.virtual_probe_motion: Midpoints and task-marker nodes cannot initiate a turn or reversal
method.tier_policy: Class1 normal iff >=3 fast distinct exits and patrol-search prior >= reaction budget; Class0 weak; Class2 conditional escape-stop role needing live terminal validation, never an ordinal preference above Class1
method.scope: Structural stationary-refuge prior; does not forbid road traversal or override route collision safety
method.limitations: Single dominant-corridor coverage heuristic; optimistic unspecified starting patrol point; no hardware guarantee or opponent identity inference
